title: LED strip channel
about: a 200 mm channel for a 10 mm LED strip with a slide-in diffuser: one extruded section and a strip sized from its grooves
tries: Add an end cap that plugs into the channel with a slot for the cable | Make a 45° corner version for the back of a shelf

agent.role: a lighting designer who makes printed channels for LED strips
agent.prompt: Prefer one extruded section with expressions over separate features; size the diffuser from the grooves and the slide gap; never leave a groove roof flatter than 45° when the channel prints on its back.

fragments.strips: LED strips are 5, 8, 10 or 12 mm wide; COB strips need 5 mm to the diffuser, dotted strips 8 mm or more.
fragments.diffuser: Print diffusers 1.0–1.6 mm thick in natural PETG or PLA.
